US Strikes Iran After Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz

The U.S. military conducted new strikes against Iran following projectile attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The incidents have disrupted shipping, with four oil and gas tankers reportedly turning back from the area due to security fears. The situation has raised concerns about oil prices and regional stability.
